mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a warm 80 degrees under clear skies at Verona City Hall with the moon currently in its Third Quarter phase.

City officials announced that Phase two of the Highway M construction begins the week of September 7, which will shift traffic into the eastbound lanes for about three weeks. Also, a new public art sculpture titled Tai Chi Animal Frolics has been installed at Century School Park.

We have a full slate of fun starting with live music today at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee. Looking ahead, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market tomorrow or head to Paddy Mac's for more live music.
In our weekly look at noteworthy calls, on August 30, an officer observed a vehicle versus bicyclist crash on East Verona Avenue at Lincoln Street where the driver was cited for failure to yield.
Today is a great day to visit for the Chocolate Volcano flavor, and you can stop by when the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
